items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: Carol Bash’s film, “The Lady Who Swings the Band” on Mary Lou Williams just came out

ctx.x: Well I just talked to someone who went on an incredible jazz cruise. Like everybody was there.

Um hm. Well maybe that’s another way of getting out there. And hopefully what I hope will happen too is you know Carol Bash’s film, “The Lady Who Swings the Band” on Mary Lou Williams just came out, and of course it’s been a while since Ken Burns’ film on jazz came out. I think it’s time for another film like that, another documentary like that. And some gentleman came to me from some neat company in Europe and they did ask me questions for a film that they’re doing on jazz, which I hope will come out soon. So…
You know what I think about that, I think they need something to write about. When’s the last time anybody wrote jazz is dead? Okay, that was five years ago, it’s time to do it again.
